title: The Blood Pressure row's "Target <120/80 · Aug 2026" wraps to two lines at 375 and 390 when a previous value shows, against US-62 AC8a's one-line claim
evidence: Found on main (9ac060dca) in PR 1710 (H83), real WebKit, iPhone 13 profile, SI, a man of 51 at 178 cm with two pressures (126/80 after 132/84). The meta line breaks after "Aug", leaving "2026" on its own line; the Range line count is 2 at both 375 and 390, in SI and US units. US-62 AC8a says the trend stays 44 wide below 390px so "Target <120/80 · Aug 2026" keeps one line at 375px; the bracketed previous "(132/84)" widens the reading column. Shots: h83-rows-si-375-bp.png and h83-rows-si-390-bp.png (and the us ones), listed in PR 1710's body. (H104)
